description: Use when the user wants to see an object of given size in their room at real scale: furniture, a box, a parcel or a TV. Returns one link opening the Spatial answer in the SceneView Android app; without the app, the web page shows the size and offers the app. Represents the object's bounding box using the sizes the user said (dimensionSource: user) or the assistant estimated (estimated). No fit detection and no accuracy claim. Dimensions are width, height, depth in centimetres.

depthCm.description: Depth in centimetres, front to back.

dimensionSource.description: "user" when the user gave the sizes, "estimated" when you estimated them (say so in your answer).

heightCm.description: Height in centimetres, from the floor or table up.

label.description: Short name shown with the box, e.g. "Desk" or "55-inch TV".

placement.description: Where the object stands: on the floor (furniture) or on a table (a parcel, a speaker).

widthCm.description: Width in centimetres, left to right as you face the object (a desk's length).

name: show_in_space
